bead.title: bench-pr-A3: per-cell execution loop, report.json composition, budget halting, per-cell retry
bead.description:
PROBLEM: With the runner front end (A2) and adapters/image (A1) in place, the runner must actually run cells: invoke the harness adapter and task executor, compose report.json, enforce the cost budget, and retry transient failures. This is the body of the run loop.

ROOT CAUSE:
- cmd/bench/matrix.go (~2232 LOC) owns the execution loop, report composition, and budget logic being ported to bash.

PROPOSED FIX:
- Per-cell loop in scripts/benchmark/benchmark: write cell-state.json sentinel; invoke harness-adapters/<name> command < profile.json -> command-spec.json; compose task-spec; invoke task-executors/<name> < task-spec.json (writes cell_dir/result.json); compose cell_dir/report.json embedding profile, command, env_redacted, fiz.txt, fiz.err, session/; copy task_executor_version + harbor_runner_image_digest from <out>/sweep.json into each cell; delete cell-state.json on clean close.
- Resume: if cell_dir/report.json exists with a terminal final_status, skip. --force-rerun ignores. --retry-invalid reruns cells with non-empty invalid_class OR an orphan cell-state.json.
- Budget: at cell close compute cost_usd_at_run_time from profile.pricing x token streams; accumulate into <out>/budget.json; before the next cell, halt when the cap is hit. Skipped cells get final_status=budget_halted placeholders (process_outcome=setup_failed, with a 'note' field).
- Per-cell retry: bounded exponential backoff for transient errors (connection refused, 5xx, EOF parse). Write attempt_of: into the new cell and back-write superseded_by: into the prior closed cell (the one permitted mutation of a closed cell).

NON-SCOPE: arg parsing / matrix / --plan (A2); adapters + image (A1); flock/setsid/job-pool concurrency and SIGINT/SIGTERM handling (A4); Go agent-leak fix, Go deactivation, parity (A5). Parent out-of-scope preserved: PR B schema; PR C bench-set schema; PR D collector; PR E importers; PR F deleting cmd/bench; PR G docs. Governing artifact plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

DEPENDS ON: A2 (and transitively A1). BLOCKS: A4.

ACCEPTANCE (satisfies parent AC2 and AC3):
1. ./scripts/benchmark/benchmark --profile sindri-lucebox --bench-set tb-2-1-canary runs the canary and produces cells under bench/results/fiz-tools-v1/cells/; each cell has report.json embedding profile, command, env_redacted, fiz.txt, fiz.err, session/. TestRunProducesCellReports. (parent AC2)
2. Re-running without --force-rerun skips cells whose report.json has a terminal final_status; --retry-invalid reruns invalid/orphan cells. TestResumeAndRetryInvalid.
3. ./scripts/benchmark/benchmark --profile sindri-lucebox --bench-set tb-2-1-canary --max-cost-usd 0.01 produces at least one cell with final_status=budget_halted (process_outcome=setup_failed, note set). TestBudgetHaltPlaceholder. (parent AC3)
4. A transient adapter failure yields a retry cell carrying attempt_of: and a superseded_by: back-written into the prior cell. TestPerCellRetryLinks.
GATES: bats scripts/benchmark/test passes; `go test ./...` passes; `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
bead.acceptance: Parent AC2 and AC3 hold; acceptance 1-4 pass; bats, go test ./..., and lefthook run pre-commit all green.
